native.bitrate: Lowest mandatory baseline 9600 baud; six documented standard rates. Actual stations must agree; no historical optional 115200 default or arbitrary continuous rate.
native.payload_bytes: Encoded APDU, not 501-byte MS/TP NPDU. CLASSIC maximum 480; EXTENDED up to 1476, actual accepted peer APDU further limits it. Unknown actual service encoding.
native.bacnet_device_instance: Assigned BACnet identity, not station MAC. 0..4194302, wildcard 4194303 excluded; no invented identity.
native.bacnet_max_apdu_bytes: Actual accepted APDU property. Device may use 256, not only six header-encoding codes. CLASSIC <=480, EXTENDED <=1476; PICS required.
native.bacnet_segmentation: Actual PICS capability unknown; transmission/reception distinct.
native.bacnet_apdu_retries: Confirmed-service retry default 3, no-retry devices may use zero; separate from token retry.
native.bacnet_apdu_timeout_modifiable: Actual device boolean selects the conditional literature proposal.
native.bacnet_apdu_timeout_ms: Default 3000 ms when modifiable, 60000 otherwise; unknown condition leaves value open. Actual configured values preserved. Positive with positive retries.
native.bacnet_segment_timeout_ms: Default proposal 2000 ms for supported segmentation; positive with retries. Not MS/TP reply timeout or project deadline.
native.mstp_frame_format: CLASSIC baseline proposal; EXTENDED requires actual capability. No automatic extended support.
native.mstp_node_role: Actual MASTER/SLAVE role unknown; slave replies only.
native.mstp_mac_address: Actual station 0..254, master <=127 and Max_Master. Broadcast 255 is not a station.
native.mstp_max_info_frames: Default 1 frame per token; actual upper device bound unknown.
native.mstp_serial_format: Fixed 8N1; start/stop overhead distinct from APDU bytes.
native.mstp_reply_timeout_ms: Normative comment 255..300 ms, proposal 255. Implementation constant 250 is not normative.
native.mstp_turnaround_bit_times: Minimum 40 bit times proposal; baud-dependent duration.
native.mstp_token_retries: One token retry, distinct from APDU retry.
native.mstp_frame_abort_bit_times: Minimum 60 bit times; <=100 ms via actual baud.
native.mstp_npdu_bytes: Actual data field unknown; classic <=501, extended <=1497. At least two NPDU header bytes; routed headers longer. Not an executed encoder.
